Subject: Next steps: evaluation kickoff & success criteria (scheduling + security)

Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciated the context on your clinical-search pilot and the three high-level success measures you shared (recall on clinician queries, latency under 500ms, and redaction/PHI handling). To keep momentum, proposed next step is an evaluation kickoff where we: 1) align success criteria and concrete prompts, 2) review a lightweight trial plan (2-week pilot scope + metrics), and 3) run through security expectations (SOC2 excerpt + data handling).

Can you confirm who from your side should join the kickoff? You mentioned a PM and someone from security — if we can get a CISO or security lead on the thread that helps unblock the questionnaire.

I’ve proposed three 60-minute slots below (PST) — please pick any that work or reply with alternatives and we’ll send a calendar invite:
- Wed Aug 12, 10:00–11:00am
- Thu Aug 13, 2:00–3:00pm
- Fri Aug 14, 9:00–10:00am

Attached: redwood-eval-playbook.pdf (draft trial plan + prompt examples) and SOC2-extract-2025.pdf (controls summary).

Notes / asks for kickoff prep:
- Priya: please share a short list (5–10) of representative clinician queries you want us to evaluate.
- Tom: any data-transfer constraints or allowlist IPs we should know about for the trial VPC?
- Marissa / Karthik (copied): please prepare a short demo focused on prompt engineering and prompt-set evaluation, plus a simple dashboard view for the metrics above.

Happy to jump on a quick sync if you’d prefer another time.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191
